text: Ensnared is a special Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Nopon, Kuta caught in a cage trap, Kuta's Cargo, with Aisha the cat sitting atop the trap involved during Castle in the Sky. It is obtained as a reward for completing this Normal Mission.
Energy Mist Screen is an armor Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X that nullifies the debuffs and buffs from energy mist weather.
Ether Attack Plus is a ground weapon attack Augment in and that increases the damage dealt by all ether-attribute weapons and Arts. The Skell equivalent is AttributeDmg.ETHER.
Enraged (Japanese: , ikari, anger or hatred) is a recurrent enemy-exclusive buff in the .
Elma's Bodywear is Light Wear torso armor in and . It is manufactured by Grenada Galactic Group. It is part of Elma's initial gear at the beginning of the game, and cannot be obtained any other way.

Elma's Armwear L is Light Wear left arm armor in and . It is manufactured by Grenada Galactic Group. It is part of Elma's initial gear at the beginning of the game, and cannot be obtained any other way.

Elma's Armwear R is Light Wear right arm armor in and . It is manufactured by Grenada Galactic Group. It is part of Elma's initial gear at the beginning of the game, and cannot be obtained any other way.
Elma's Legwear is Light Wear leg armor in and . It is manufactured by Grenada Galactic Group. It is part of Elma's initial gear at the beginning of the game, and cannot be obtained any other way.

Elysium (Japanese: , Rakuen, lit. Eden, Paradise) is a location in . It is a fabled paradise supposedly located at the top of the World Tree in the center of Alrest. Rex and Pyra's quest to Elysium, and the struggles they face to reach it, form the main premise of the story. The Aegises are able to visit an imaginary version of Elysium in their dreams, created from their own memories. This distant memory appears multiple times during the course of the game.

Esse Glyphs are rare materials in . As a glyph, they can only be dropped by Unique Monsters between levels 40 and 49. According to their description, the truth of existence is inscribed on them and like every glyph, they sell for a high price on the market.

The Empire of Mor Ardain (Japanese: , Superubia Teikoku, lit. Superbia Empire) is a Nation in . It is a militaristic empire from the Titan Mor Ardain. They are led by the Emperor Niall. They control Titans through mechanical means, and bring heavy armaments as they annex other lands in a bid to save their own from ruin and depletion. In particular, they use geothermal energy from steam turbine towers, as their home Titan, Mor Ardain, had its internal temperature increasingly rising as it nears to its death, allowing the Empire to maintain an advanced mechanical technology. The Empire occupies other regions of Alrest with bases such as the Torigoth Relay Base in the Gormott Province and the A

The Entrance (Japanese: , Entoransu) is a location in . It is located in the Ancient Ship, and can thus only be accessed during Chapter 1. It is the second location visited in the Ancient Ship, after the Ancient Ship, Deck, and leads between the Ship Helm and the Ship Bridge, Mid-Deck.
Elephant Press (Japanese: , Erefantopuresu) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using a Shield Hammer.

Estral Steaks are Meat Pouch items in . They can be purchased at Gryff Butchers run by Yofan in the Gormott Province's Torigoth and at Icarus Butchers run by Severtine in the Indoline Praetorium. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Godfrey.

Epicurean Ligia (Japanese: , Bishoku no Rōchi) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Lysaat family and a Driver, and can be found at level 48 in the middle of the Lud Cloudway in the Leftherian Archipelago. It must be defeated in order to unlock Brighid's level 5 Swirling Dragon and Dahlia's level 5 Crystal Blizzard Blade Specials.
The Engine Room (Japanese: , Kikanshitsu) is a location in . It is located on the Titan Battleship in the Gormott Province, beyond the Port-side Walkway and leading to the Mid-ship Walkway Door.
The Ether Control Tower (Japanese: , Ēteru Kanri-tō) is a Location in . It is located in the Old Factory in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

The Entertainment District (Japanese: , Fonsu Maimu Gekijō-ku) of Fonsa Myma is a Location in . It is located above the Commercial District, with more stairs leading up to the Uraya Merc Barracks and Sevind Palace Plaza.
Elmos Square (Japanese: , Erumu Hiroba) is a Location in . It is located in the center of Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal. It is the location of several different shops.

Elpys Great Hall (Japanese: , Erupisu Daikūdō) is a landmark in . It is located on the Mid Level of Spirit Crucible Elpys, consists of a series of platforms and caves over an abyss, and can be reached from the Helical Cloister. It leads to the Cenotaph Bridge.
Enlightened Morris (Japanese: , Kakusei no Morisu) is a Unique Monster in . He is a member of the Pippito family and can be found at level 42 inside Pippito's Haunt in the Kingdom of Tantal.
Estral Quotelettas are Meat Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Bassani Butchers in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. Six are needed to Unlock Cressidus' Level 5 Dead Ball.
Emperor Ephem's War are Literature items in . They can be purchased from Haskefell Books in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
The Elgeschel Deeds are Store Deed items in . They can be purchased from the Elgeschel Hobby Store in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Elgeschel Hobby Store is a shop in . It is run by Noagh and can be found in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. It is specialized in Board Games.
Electro Buster (Japanese: , Erekibasutā) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using a Big Bang Edge.
Ellooks (Japanese: , Erūku) are enemies in the . They resemble elks, with gold or silver adornments, similar to Cervuses in . They come in white and gold varieties.

Emerald Piranhax (Japanese: , Emerarudo Samon) are enemies in . They are members of the Piranhax family and can be found at level 39-42 on the Upper Level - Right of the Gormott Province, particularly in eastern Coolley Lake or at Varnax's Plunge. Up to five weaker versions of this enemy can be summoned at level 40-42 by Venal Montgomery's art "Sumo Press", if used next to water.
Elidor Parisax (Japanese: , Eridōra Parasu) are enemies in . They are members of the Parisax family and can be found at level 55 - 58 inside the Womb Hollow in the Land of Morytha.

Emblazoned Rays are Fish collectibles in . They can be found in the Leftherian Archipelago, in particular at Godsford Isle in the east body of water, or on the Isle of Sleeping Remains inside Peerless Beaufort's shell. Two are required to cook Acqua Pearl Pazza.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Eraser Orbs (Japanese: , Ireizā Ōbu) are accessories in and . They increase all damage dealt by up to 110% when at least one party member is incapacitated. They are the upgraded version of the Dark Orb accessory. The Bloody Orb and Demon Orb accessories offer stronger instances of this equipment's effect.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Ester Shoes (Japanese: , Esuteru Shūzu) are accessories in . They increase the wearer's Agility stat by up to 32%. They are the upgraded version of the Shell Shoes and Assassin Shoes accessories. The DLC exclusive Dauntless Boots accessory offers a stronger instance of this equipment's effect. For a similar additive effect that can stack with this gear, check the Wolf Shoes and Spring Shoes accessories.
Elima Leaves are Tree collectibles in . They can be found on the World Tree.

Ensorceled Maps are Treasure items in . They can be obtained through Salvaging at Goetuis Wharf #1 in the Indoline Praetorium, or at Rigitte Harbor, Daridan's Stack or Ansel Hatchery in the Leftherian Archipelago.
Eryagh Pods (Japanese: , Eriagu Poddo) are enemies in . They are Pods that can be found at level 45-47 at the Chamber of Offering on the Mid Level of the Spirit Crucible Elpys.

Empress Arachnos (Japanese: , Enpuresu Supaido) are enemies in . They are members of the Arachno family, and can be found at level 46 - 48 at the Chamber of Offering on the Mid Level of the Spirit Crucible Elpys.

Engine Chips are Core Chips in and . They can be purchased at the Casheefs Blacksmiths shop in the Kingdom of Tantal, rewarded for Further Feeding Issues and dropped by Xane Pippitos. Engine Chips share their appearances with Battery Chips, Booster Chips, and Motor Chip. __TOC__

The Enraged Gogol (Japanese: , Gekkō no Gogōru) is a quest-exclusive Boss in . It is a member of the Gogol family, and is found in the Kingdom of Tantal during Tender-Hearted Beast. It is fought once at the Zalmor's Crevice and then two more times on the path to the Sacred Ice Caverns.
Epplid is an NPC in . Epplid is an Urayan who can be found in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya. Epplid runs a shop called Unita Trading specialized in exchange.

Eluned is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian child who can be found in the Grodd Residential Zone in the Gormott Province. Eluned gives the quest A Young Man's Prize. Upon its completion, he moves to Garagorm's Arch alongside Leif.
Emillian is an NPC in . Emillian is a Tantalese who can be found at the Soprac Old Market in the Kingdom of Tantal.

Ememeh is an NPC in . Ememeh is a Nopon who can be found at the Argentum Bazaar in the Argentum Trade Guild. However, she is only interacted with during the Heart-to-Heart "Sheba's Dream". Otherwise, she cannot be spoken to or interacted with in any way.
Enada Lysaats (Japanese: , Endā Shīsu) are enemies in . They are members of the Lysaat family, and can be found at level 45-49 at the Morytha Falls at the Cliffs of Morytha after Salvaging.
Eternal Spirit (Japanese: , Eikyūfuhen no Seishin) is a Blade Quest in . It can be received from Perun at the Central Exchange in the Argentum Trade Guild.

The Ether Bottle is a Key Item in . It is obtained by Salvaging at Port Anangham in the Empire of Mor Ardain. The Info Item Switch Parts 1 provides information about this Key Item. It is one of the three key items needed to open the chest in the quest Bana's Secret Treasure.

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Element Orb Prioritizer (Japanese: , Zokusei-dama Yūsen Hakai) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM / Upgrade in and . When using a Blade equipped with this core in a Chain Attack, it makes their attacks prioritize orbs that are already damaged if no elemental orb of their opposite element is available, instead of selecting an orb at random. The higher the damage on an orb, the higher its priority, but the targeted orb will still be randomly chosen between multiple orbs if they all share the highest damage value. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Emergency Guard (Japanese: , Kinkyū Gādo) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM/Upgrade in and . It increases Block Rate by up to 35% when the user's HP is at 30% or lower. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. Poppi QT is not compatible with this part. __TOC__

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Endurance (Japanese: , Nintai) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM/Upgrade in and . It reduces damage taken by up to 22% when the user's HP is at 30% or lower. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. Poppi QT is not compatible with this part. __TOC__

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Ether Defense Up (Japanese: , Ēteru Bōgyo Appu) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM/Upgrade in and . It boosts the user's Ether Defense by up to 22%. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. Poppi α is not compatible with this part. __TOC__
Enzozo is an NPC in . He can be found on the roofs of the Admar Storage Zone in the Empire of Mor Ardain during The Ties That Bind.
Elnatauro Inn is a shop in . It can be found at Goetuis Port in the Indoline Praetorium. It is an inn run by Adalbert. A Short Rest costs 250 to 500 G, depending on the Development Level of Indol.
Errol (Japanese: , Iruro) is an NPC in . He is a Gormotti who can be found in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Elgo is an NPC in . He is a Gormotti worker at the Saets Lumber Co. in the Gormott Province. He can be found during the day, during the quest Nature Boy.

This page lists all the Merc Missions available in the Empire of Mor Ardain. The list may be viewed in the order they appear in the Merc Group Log. Terms and abbreviations are explained in the legend at the bottom of the page. |-| Mission Log = Mission Log |-| Requirements and Rewards = Requirements and Rewards * Base reward values for Gold and Experience are increased with higher Merc Levels.

Eternal Rest is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located on the platform in the Vault of Heroes in the Spirit Crucible Elpys. It features a conversation between Rex, Zeke, Mòrag, Gramps, Brighid, and Pandoria about the Leftherian Titans, the formation of the Leftherian Archipelago and where the protagonists want to be buried.

Eslan is an NPC in . She is an Ardainian who stands by Smaghi on the pathway to Garfont's Training Ground in the Kingdom of Uraya. She is a positive merc who calls Rex's group "saviors" and shows her appreciation for their work in the merc group and with helping Alrest.

Electroshade Twist (Japanese: , Den'ei tsuisuto) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when using a Brilliant Twinblades. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Zeke's Rapid Twist.
Eliviel is an NPC in . She is an Indoline who can be found during the day at the Seoris Plaza West Gate in the Indoline Praetorium. She offers the Merc Mission Taminbi Theft.
Elemental Core: Dark is an Elemental Core in . It changes Poppi's element to Dark. It can be used to customize Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ's element. Poppi α is not compatible with this part. __TOC__

Elemental Core: Earth is an Elemental Core in . It changes Poppi's element to Earth. Poppi α starts equipped with this core by default. It can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ's element. __TOC__

Elemental Core: Electric is an Elemental Core in . It changes Poppi's element to Electric. It can be used to customize Poppi α and Poppi QTπ's element. Poppi QT is not compatible with this part. __TOC__

Elemental Core: Fire is an Elemental Core in . It changes Poppi's element to Fire. Poppi QT starts equipped with this core by default. It can be used to customize Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ's element. Poppi α is not compatible with this part. __TOC__

Elemental Core: Ice is an Elemental Core in . It changes Poppi's element to Ice. Poppi QTπ starts equipped with this core by default. It can be used to customize Poppi α and Poppi QTπ's element. Poppi QT is not compatible with this part. __TOC__
Elemental Core: Light is an Elemental Core in . It changes Poppi's element to Light. It can be used to customize Poppi QTπ's element. Poppi α and Poppi QT are not compatible with this part. __TOC__
Elemental Core: Water is an Elemental Core in . It changes Poppi's element to Water. It can be used to customize Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ's element. Poppi α is not compatible with this part. __TOC__
Elemental Core: Wind is an Elemental Core in . It changes Poppi's element to Wind. It can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ's element. __TOC__

Encourage is a Skill RAM/Upgrade in . It increases Affinity by up to 20 every time a party member misses an attack. It can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__
Ellenora is an NPC in . She is an Ardainian who can be found at the Nharil Central Plaza in the Empire of Mor Ardain. She offers the quest Failure and Success.
Eltonos is an NPC in . He is a Leftherian who can be found at Ysheva Harbor in the Leftherian Archipelago.
Eltetra is an NPC in . She is an Indoline who can be found at Poldis Circle in the Indoline Praetorium. She runs the shop Silktu Textiles.
Element Orbs are an Info Item in . It can be purchased from the Informant shop at the Plaza of Reprieve in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Enemy Reinforcements are an Info Item in . It can be purchased from the Informant shop at the Plaza of Reprieve in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Enemy Detection is an Info Item in . It can be purchased from Darryth, the Informant in Fonsa Myma, for a base price of 700 G.

The Engineer Tirkin (Japanese: , Enjinia Tākin) is a Story Exclusive Enemy in . It is a member of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 32 at the Ether Control Tower in the Old Factory of the Empire of Mor Ardain during a story event. It drops the Ether Tank Key when defeated.

Embercake Zeke (Japanese: , Jīku Shinku Haō Fōmu) is a DLC Accessory in . It can be purchased at the DLC shop Noponstone Exchange for 30 Noponstones in the Land of Challenge obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. The Accessory gives Zeke blond hair and a red coat with white trousers. Its effect is functionally identical to the legendary version of the Optical Headband accessory as well as the common version of the Crimson Headband accessory, and is shared with the Shining Justice Zeke DLC accessory.

Ether Cubes are items and battle mechanics in . They are dropped by enemies during Challenge Battles when they are killed or in a combo, appear as orange cubes on the ground, and disappear after a short time. An Ether Cube dropped by an enemy may represent multiple, showing a cube symbol and the number of cubes received upon picking it up. Challenge Battles are available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. They are used to measure success in a Challenge Battle. The more Ether Cubes the player picks up during the Challenge, the more rewards will be given upon completion.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Enlightened Loinclothes (Japanese: , Rakan no Fundoshi) are DLC accessories in . They increase damage dealt while the Driver has a female Blade engaged by up to 85%. They are the upgraded version of the Male Loincloth accessory. The Enlightened Loincloth can only be equipped exclusively by male Drivers (Rex, Tora, Vandham and Zeke). The female equivalent is the Glamorous Swimsuit. They can be found in the Land of Challenge from Treasure Troves obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Envoy's Footgears (Japanese: , Denrei Shūzu) are DLC accessories in . They make the wearer take up to 20% less damage from enemy attacks, in exchange of decreasing their damage output by up to 40%. The DLC exclusive Survivor's Footgear accessory offers a stronger instance of this equipment's effect. They can be found in the Land of Challenge from Treasure Troves obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass.
Elis is a young Gormotti in . He is an aspiring botanist and can be found on the top level of the Galad Residential Zone in Torigoth, Gormott.

|-|XC2 = |-|TTGC = Ellook Horns are Enemy Part collectibles in and . They can be dropped by Ripbik Ellooks in the Kingdom of Tantal during the DLC Quest Artisanal Accessories upon installing the New Quests Pack 4 of the Expansion Pass.

Elma: Redux is a Challenge Battle in . Once completed, the player obtains the Alrest Link Relay and is able to use Elma as a Blade outside of the Land of Challenge. Similarly to Otherworldly Fighter, the music track "Uncontrollable" from plays, and the challenge takes place at the Cobalt Cliffs in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Energy Stir-Fries are Staple Food items in . They can be created by Jin at Campsites.
Eternity Perfumes are Fragrance items in . They can be created by Brighid at Campsites.

Elemental Rebound is a debuff found in . It is only seen on two enemy Arts; Reverse Bolt, used by Radclyffe-type Sovereigns, and a certain variant of Tail Slap, most notably used by the Superboss Reeking Douglas when he is Enraged. However, Radclyffe-type Sovereigns will only use Reverse Bolt if they are inflicted with an Electric-element Blade Combo. Elemental Rebound has a chance to inflict a Level 1 Blade Combo of the same element that the user is currently inflicted with, which inflicts Damage-over-Time. However, if a Blade Combo deals damage while the text popup for "Elemental Rebound" is still on-screen, the character that inflicted the Blade Combo will be hit with it's full damage ins
Episto Tirkin (Japanese: , Episuto Tākin) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 36-38 at the Saints' Practice Grounds in Gormott.

Ers Skeeter (Japanese: , Ēru Sukīto) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Skeeter family, and can be found at level 12-16 on Outlook Knoll, Ordia Great Plains, Serene Springside, Valafum Hill, and Lyanne Meadow in Gormott.
Espina Feris (Japanese: , Esupina Ferisu) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Feris family, and can be found at level 11-18 on Ordia Great Plains and ‎Lyanne Meadow in Gormott.

Elegiac Mercenaries are four quest exclusive enemies in . They are Ardainian Mercenaries who can be found at level 52 on the rooftops adjacent to the Fabri Industry Ward of Auresco in the Kingdom of Torna during A Rare Sense of Justice. As with all quest-exclusive enemies in , they drop no items, only Gold.
Esasa is an NPC in . She is a Nopon who can be found at Rigitte Harbor in the Leftherian Archipelago.
Eternity Loam is a Key Item in . It can be found at Loftin Nature Preserve and is needed for Unforgotten Promise.
Ether Exploitation (Japanese: , Ēteru Kōshō no Saikutsu) is a quest in . It can be received from Carranelle at the Companions' Cape on Bionis' Shoulder, or later at the Grand Arch in Gran Dell.
Ether Font (Japanese: , Ēteru no Izumi) is a quest in . It can be received from Tulleana at Companions' Cape on Bionis' Shoulder, or later at the Grand Arch in Gran Dell.

The Eternal Zenith (Japanese: , Yūkyū no Tenchō) is a Secret Area in . It is located in Gran Dell on the Bionis' Shoulder. It can be reached from the Grand Arch by following the spiraling pathway to the top, jumping up the rubble where the path has crumbled. The Eternal Zenith is a great viewpoint, and can also be seen from most of the map.
The Eternity Way (Ruined) (Japanese: , Eien no Renrakutsūro-ato) is a location in . It is located in Alcamoth.

Eryth Corsages are light head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition. They can be obtained as rewards after clearing the Time Attack challenge Oh, Brother!. They can only be worn by Melia.
Eryth Tops are light torso armour in . They can be obtained as rewards after clearing the Time Attack challenge Oh, Brother!. They can only be worn by Melia.
Eryth Bracelets are light arms armour in . They can be obtained as rewards after clearing the Time Attack challenge Oh, Brother!. They can only be worn by Melia.
Eryth Skirts are light legs armour in . They can be obtained as rewards after clearing the Time Attack challenge Oh, Brother!. They can only be worn by Melia.
Eryth Sandals are light feet armour in . They can be obtained as rewards after clearing the Time Attack challenge Oh, Brother!. They can only be worn by Melia.
Empyreal Gauntlets are medium arms armour in and . They can be bought at shops for 2,200 G.
Empyreal Girdles are medium legs armour in and . They can be bought at shops for 2,350 G.
Empyreal Helms are medium head armour in and . They can be bought at shops for 1,730 G.
Empyreal Greaves are medium feet armour in and . They can be bought at shops for 3,300 G.
Empyreal Cuirass are medium torso armour in and . They can be bought at shops for 5,400 G.
Elysium, in the Blue Sky is a track from , composed by Yasunori Mitsuda. It is track two of disc one on the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack. It plays during the second cutscene of the game.
Escorpión (Japanese: , Esukorupion) is Addam and Minoth's Level IV Blade Special in . If Escorpión is activated by Addam, the special's element will be determined by the Greatsword he has equipped.
Empyrean Salvo (Japanese: ) is Herald's Level I Blade Special in .
Electrifying Show (Japanese: ) is Electra's Level IV Blade Special in .
Engrave (Japanese: , Engureibu) is Sever's Level II Blade Special in . With the weapon in "sword form", Sever performs a flurry of thrusts.
Electricite is a Key Item in . It can be crafted by Hugo at Campsites.

Equites (Japanese: , Ekuitesu) are enemies in . They are Kevesi Levnises, and can be found at level 15 in Eagus Wilderness and Bennel Cave, level 19 - 21 in Caitlin Drum, 30 - 47 in Yzana Plains and Captocorn Peak in the Aetia Region, and in Keves Castle. One is seen accompanying Valdi alongside a Velites during his Hero Quest, 2 more aid Garvel, Layla, and Hoope during their boss fight during Lanz's Hero Quest, and Joran was run over by one's wheel in one of his past lives prior to becoming a Moebius. They drop Equites Tank Wheels and Loading Cores when defeated.
Ethel (Japanese: , Eseru), is a character in . She was designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.
Ether Collider (Japanese: , Ēterukoredā) is a Battle Art in . It is one of Eunie's Ouroboros arts.

Elite Monsters are enemies in and . They are monsters that are stronger than Normal Monsters. They can be identified by having blue-colored wing decorations on either side of their level tag. Among generic enemies of the same level and species, they are the second-strongest type of enemy, only beaten by Unique Monsters. Most Elite monsters are simply stronger versions of enemies of the same species, making them tougher to kill than normal monsters. However, some enemy types only appear as Elite monsters. When battling an Elite monster, the track A Formidable Enemy will be played over the regular battle theme, unless a Unique Monster is present in the fight. Defeating an Elite monster yields
Elsie's Spout (Japanese: , Erushī no Taki) is a Landmark in , located in Ribbi Flats.

Ether Cannon (Japanese: , Ēterukyanon) is a Battle Art in . It is one of the arts used by the Medic Gunner class. Ether Cannon is unlocked as a usable Master Art upon reaching Rank 10 with Medic Gunner.
Ether Channels (Japanese: , Ēteruchaneru) are special spots in and .

Energy Grenade (Japanese: , Enajīgurenēdo) is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Yumsmith class. It becomes a usable Master Art upon unlocking the class. Upon use, it creates a field effect inflicting damage to enemies standing in the field. Affected enemies take 50% of user's Attack as damage every second.
Eternal Elegance (Japanese: , Kuon no Fūin) is a Secret Area in , located within the Lost Colony in Erythia Sea.
Elevator No. 1 (Japanese: , Daiichi Erebētā) is a Location in . It is located in the Urayan Tunnels.
Elevator No. 2 (Japanese: , Daini Erebētā) is a Location in . It is located in the Urayan Tunnels.
Elevator No. 3 (Japanese: , Daisan Erebētā) is a Location in . It is located in the Urayan Tunnels.
The Engardo Pass Camp (Japanese: , Endado-tōge no Kyūsokuchi) is a Rest Spot in . It is located at Engardo Pass in High Maktha Wildwood. The Pass Caravan is located here.
Engardo Pass (Japanese: , Endado-tōge) is a Location in . It is located in the High Maktha Wildwood.
Equipment Storage (Japanese: , Bihin Hokanshitsu) is a Rest Spot in . It is located on the third floor of Keves Castle.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Engineer Gloves are Accessories in and . The common variant can be purchased from the Colony Tau Commissary and Old Way Caravan. The legendary variant can be purchased from the Prize X-change Blue or obtained from Gallivanter Buckley. In , the legendary variant can be obtained from Dragon God Alcar.

The Eternal Canopy (Japanese: , Yūkyū no Tenban) is a Landmark in , located on Daedal Isle in Erythia Sea. It is the Centre Gate from Eryth Sea, but with the transporter to Alcamoth now broken down. It is accessed from the Tengate Ruins.
The Elgares Depths Entrance (Japanese: , Erugaresu Chika Dōkutsu Iriguchi) is a Landmark in . It is located in Millick Meadows. It serves as the entrance into the Elgares Depths.

Elgares Depths (Japanese: , Erugaresu Chika Dōkutsu) is a location in , located in Millick Meadows. The Unique Monster Fang-King Clavein can be found at the cave's end. With the exception of Fang-King Clavein and his summoned Grebels, all monsters found here are Elite Monsters.
Elsayer Cape (Japanese: , Erusea Sankyō) is a Location in . It is located on Rae-Bel Tableland in the Fornis Region.
The Eternal Prison (Japanese: , Eigō no Kangoku) is a Landmark in , located in the Origin Interior. It is where Melia was imprisoned by Z, and the location of the party's final confrontation with N.
Enpedias are a family of enemies in . They are only found in Origin.
Empress Lettuces are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Fornis Region. They can also be purchased from the Colony Iota Caravan, or produced from the Desert Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Elegant Pummelos are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Fornis Region. They can also be purchased from the Colony Iota Caravan, or produced from the Tableland Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.

Ethel's Ferronis (Japanese: , Eseru no Tetsu Kyoshin) is a Boss in . Ethel pilots this Ferronis made by the Consuls to have her and Cammuravi defeat Ouroboros. It is fought alongside Cammuravi's Ferronis at level 35 at Engardo Pass in High Maktha Wildwood.
Escalargots are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be produced from the Sandbar Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Endurmics are Collectible items in . They can be found in Swordmarch. They can also be produced from the Perimeter Outlet Fabricator after the first step of Colony 0 renovation.

Enpedia Headpieces are items in . They can be dropped by Pressing Rafeel and Faroos Enpedia in Origin Interior, Hangar, Lower: Main Gate and by Hyadet Enpedia in Origin Interior Defense Tower 3. They are commonly used to craft the following gems, Ironclad X, Disperse Bloodlust VII, Perilous Presence IX, and Refined Incantation X.

Eruno Kananuses are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Kananus family, and can be found at level 68-69 at Central Defense in the Origin Interior. They commonly drop Obsidian Kananus Mane and Kananus Razor Horn.

Eruno Myoots are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Myoot family, and can be found at level 62-63 at Amplifier No. 1, the Amplifier Section, and Ferronis Arsenals #1 and #3 in the Origin Interior.
Eruno Vokookus are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Vokooku family, and can be found at level 64-65 in the North Shell Passage and the South Shell Passage in the Origin Interior.
Enforcer Merignas are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Merigna family, and can be found at level 97-98 at the Emerald Font in Erythia Sea.
Enkrees Feris are nine Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Feris family, and can be found at level 56 in the Perimeter Woodland in Li Garte Prison Camp during Prison Spring Clean.
Element Genesis is a Talent Art in . It is the Talent Art of the Royal Summoner class.
Emergency Bandanas are Accessories in and . They can be bought from the Nopon Coin X-change for 40 Silver Nopon Coins.
The Emetater from Kite is a Key Item in . It is a toxic Emetater given to the party by Kite during Reasons to Evolve. The party brings it to Juniper to ask for their advice on the issue.
Emetaters are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Aetia Region. They can also be produced from the Battlescar Ferronis Hulk Fabricator after Reasons to Evolve has been completed.
Electro Field is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Lost Vanguard class.
Elsayer Ansels are three Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Ansel family, and are fought at level 42 at Elsayer Cape on Rae-Bel Tableland during Securing Supplies.

Eregaa Anloods (Japanese: , Eregā Haindo) are Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Anlood family, and can be found at level 33 near the Sparkling Pool Camp in High Maktha Wildwood during Stolen Provisions. They drop the Luscious Fillets needed to complete the quest.
Ether Absolute (Japanese: , Ēteru Abusoryūto) is a Chain Art in . It is Melia's Chain Art during a Chain Attack.
Elegant Maelstrom (Japanese: , Ryūrei Kageki) is a Chain Art in . It is Miyabi's Chain Art during a Chain Attack.
Empty Shell (Japanese: ) is a Battle Art in . It is a variant of Ring o' Roses that can only be used by Miyabi. She does two dancing spins fast recharging the arts of the Ouroboros party.
Etched Deep (Japanese: , Ingureibuendo) is a Battle Art in . It is a variant of Glitter Stream that is only used by Alexandria. She swings her sword around before executing a hard slash.

Elimination Beam (Japanese: , Lit. "Eliminate Beam") is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Clinging Azreel while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.

Electric Skin is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Sundappled Floria while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.

Enigmatters are DLC Key Items in . They can be purchased after completing Lapidarist Extraordinaire for 1500 red Noponstones at the Prize X-change Red and 300 blue Noponstones at the Prize X-change Blue. They are used to Craft and Enhance accessories with Masha.

Ether Anchor is a Status Effect in and . It protects the affected character from being affected by reactions such as Knockback, Blowdown, or any Combo while the buff is active. The buff will be removed prematurely if it has nullified enough reactions.
Ether Defense Down is a Status Effect in and . It reduces the affected character's ether defense.
The Enemypaedia is a mechanic in . It is similar to the Enemy Index mechanic in .
The Elevator Landing Camp (Japanese: , Shōkōki-mae no Kyūsokuchi) is a Rest Spot in , located south of the Elevator, Upper Landing on the Aurora Shelf. There is a Nopon Caravan located here.
The Elevator Landing Caravan is a shop in . It is run by a Traderpon and can be found at the Elevator Landing Camp on the Aurora Shelf.
The Elevator, Upper Landing (Japanese: , Renraku-yō Shōkōki Jōsō) is a Landmark in , located on the Aurora Shelf.
Elevator Repairs is a Scenario Quest in . Progression of this quest gives the party access to the Field Crafting mechanic.
The Enn Shoox is a Quest Exclusive Boss in . It is a member of the Shoox family, and is fought at level 26 in the Lakeside Grotto in Yesterdale during Big Game: Enn Shoox.
Ether Calamity (Japanese: , ēteru dizasutā, Lit. "Ether Disaster") is a Chain Art in . It is Na'el's Chain Art during a Chain Attack.

Eow is an NPC in . She is a former Agnus soldier who now works alongside Peridot as part of the Liberators. Her Community is gained when talking to her after having spoken to her twice and after completing Abandoned Supplies.

Emblem Adornments are items in . They can be dropped by Agnus Emblems in Aurora Shelf.
Encounter Volffs are three Quest Exclusive Bosses in . They are members of the Volff family, and can be found at level 28 on the Aurora Shelf during Where Is That Guy?.
The Emboscada Tirkin is a Quest Exclusive Boss in . It is a member of the Tirkin family that is fought at level 24 in the Agni's Tomb Ruins on the Aurora Shelf during Bobobi's Bad, Bad Day.

Elysium in the Dream is a track from and , composed by Yasunori Mitsuda. It is track ten of disc one on the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack. It is a remix of Elysium, in the Blue Sky. This track plays during the following moments in and : * Rex agrees to take Pyra to Elysium when they first meet in the dream of Elysium. * Nia reminiscing on when she first met Jin while imprisoned. * Vandham teaching Rex about the reality of life and how people can't avoid participating in war. * Pyra's story about the Aegis War. * The discussion between Addam, Mythra, Lora, Jin, Haze, and Brighid in Aletta about the bond between Drivers and Blades. * Corinne telling Pyra about when Rex first arrived in Fonse

Encroaching Malice is a track from , composed by Yasunori Mitsuda and Mariam Abounnasr. It is track fourteen of disc three from the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack, and track fourteen of disc fourteen from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays when Ethel informs the party of the available routes to Swordmarch.

|-|Chapter 1= |-|Challenge Battle Mode= Empty Moment (Japanese: , Setsuna, "Moment") is a Battle Art in . It is one of Jin's arts when he is in the party during Chapter 1 and during the Challenge Battle Titan Battleship Assault.

Elvira is a Tantalese child in . She can be found near Praximo Cosmetics and Boldarde Textiles in the Residential Area of Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal after Crossette is awakened. Approaching her with Crossette, Zeke, and Pyra in the party results in a conversation which unlocks Crossette's level 4 "Ardent Cooking". Elvira is not known to appear at any other time.
The Energy Pickles are a Key Item in . A jar of them is given to Addam by Marena at the end of Community Spirit for Addam to give to his wife.

Energy Clips are Important Items in . Collecting them increases the party's maximum reserve of aux energy, which is needed to activate Quick Cooldown. They can be received as rewards for raising the survey rate of Mira.
Eric is a NPC in . He can be found at BLADE Concourse in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles, between the BLADE Barracks and the Mimeosome Maintenance Center alongside Ted.
The Emerian Relic is an Important Item in . It is collected at the Emerian Battlegrounds in Cauldros during the course of The Emerian Battlegrounds, near Rodriguez, the Twin-Tusked.

Engage the Enemy (敵との対峙, Confrontation with the Enemy) is an Event Track in , composed and arranged by ACE+. It is track 9 of disc 1 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack, and track seventeen of disc one from the Xenoblade Definitive Edition Original Soundtrack and Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. It is also track 9 on the Xenoblade Chronicles Special Soundtrack. This music is a pre-battle theme that is heard in the following cutscenes: * When Metal Face stabs Fiora during the raid on Colony 9 * When Shulk learns Monado Speed and saves Sharla from the Mechon M71 at Spiral Valley * Before the battle against Xord at the Central Pit - Base Level. * Between battles with the Leone Tele

Ending Theme - Beyond the Sky is an Event Track in , composed and arranged by Yasunori Mitsuda, with original lyrics by Tetsuya Takahashi, English translation by Lisa Gomamoto, and vocals by Sarah Àlainn. It is track 19 of disc 2 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack, where it has the title Beyond the Sky. It is also track 12 on the Xenoblade Chronicles Special Soundtrack. This song is heard at the end of the game during Shulk and Fiora's reunion outside the new Colony 9—which is the player's first time seeing her in her newly restored Homs body—as Reyn, Riki, Sharla, and Juju go fishing off the shore nearby. Emerian Battlegrounds BC (Japanese: , Emeria Kosenjō-ato BC) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a BLADE basecamp located in the Emerian Battlegrounds in Cauldros, run by the Pathfinders.
Enrai (Japanese: , Enrai) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is located at West Gate in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles.

Enforcer Glennar (Japanese: , Aresuto Gurennā) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a member of the Prone family. He can be found at level 19 in Oblivia's Scabland Fortress during Prone Sweet Prone, during which defeating him is one of two options to get the Internment Camp Key. He can also drop materials and very rarely weapons.
Electric Resistance is a stat in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It displays resistance to electric-type attacks.
Ether Attack Up is a buff in Xenoblade Chronicles X, granted only by special weather conditions. It increases the amount of ether damage dealt.

The Ether Mine (Japanese: , Chūō Saikutsuba, lit. Central Mine) is an area beneath Colony 6 in . It has several levels, the lowest of which houses a river of Ether. It is a good source of Ether Crystals (which allows players to create their own Cylinders to create Gems). After the plot progresses, all of the Landmarks and Locations of the "Central Pit" become inaccessible.
The Ether Mine Collection is a portion of the Collectopaedia in .

Ewan (Japanese: , Iwan) is a Homs in Xenoblade Chronicles. He is an author, and can be found at the Refugee Camp on Bionis' Leg, at anytime inside the cave, then between 9:00 and 15:00 after having completed the quest A Dash of Colour. During the Colony 6 Reconstruction, he can be found at the Reconstruction HQ or near Colony 6's Main Entrance, between 21:00 and 6:00.

The Exile Fortress (Japanese: , Rukei no Toride) is a location in . It is located in Satorl Marsh, east of the Dark Swamp, southeast of the Silent Obelisk, west of the Glowing Obelisk and north of the Igna Territory. The fortress is inhabited by Ignas, it has a main entrance and a back door that can also be used to enter the fortress, but the Rear Door Key is necessary. The altar is on the roof. It can be reached by using the secret door, which is behind the throne. After completing The Giants' Treasure, the next time the party nears the altar, the Eternal Palsadia will appear and attack if it hears the party run or walk.

Ether Pebbles (Japanese: , Ēteru Pepuru) are collectables in . They can be found in the Ether Mine. According to their description, they are solidified gravelly lumps of Ether and their texture is too fine to be useful.

This quest will expire after the events at Mechonis Core. Evidence Collection (Japanese: , Shōko Atsume) is a Timed Quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Gadada after completing Adviser Hunt. He can be found in the Pollen Works in Frontier Village. If Melia is in the active party, she will comment.

Ether Roses (Japanese: , Akishii) are collectables in . They can be found in Satorl Marsh. According to their description, their white petals are lovely to look at, but their stench keeps creatures away. Five are required for the Timed Quest Going Out to Play.

Ether Penguins (Japanese: , Enperupegi) are collectables in . They can be found on the Fallen Arm. According to their description, they are penguins that have distinctive blue eyes while still looking intimidating.

Evil Rhangrot (Japanese: , Ōdō no Rangurotto) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Bunnit family, and can be found at level 6 on Tephra Hill in Colony 9. This enemy is involved in the quest Challenge 1 (Colony 9).

Ether Up (Japanese: , Ēteru Appu) is a Gem in that increases the character's Ether stat, thereby increasing the amount of damage dealt by ether-based attacks and the amount of HP recovered by healing arts. __TOC__
The Ether Light (Japanese: , Ēteru-tō) is a location in . It is located in the Hidden Machina Village on the Fallen Arm. A Heart-to-Heart - "A Night-Time Chat" - is located here.
F Speed Boosters are Mechonis boosters in Xenoblade Chronicles.

Ether Goggles (Japanese: , Ēteru Gōguru) are Mechonis goggles in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are made by fusing the tissue of Homs with Mechonis parts. They are part of Fiora's original armour, and cannot be obtained any other way.
Evening Sickles (Japanese: , Sayo no Kama) are weapons in . They are swords wielded by Dunban. Despite its description, it is not an Anti-Mechon weapon.
Ether II Boosters are Mechonis boosters in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Ether II Arms are Mechonis arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.
F Attack Frames are Mechonis frames in Xenoblade Chronicles. They were built after analysing organisms on Bionis.

F Speed Goggles (Japanese: , F Supīdo Gōguru) are Mechonis goggles in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are part of the F Speed set, along with the F Speed Frame, F Speed Arms, and F Speed Boosters. F Speed Goggles can be obtained from Mechon in Mechonis Field and the Central Factory.
F Attack Goggles (Japanese: , F Atakku Gōguru) are Mechonis goggles in Xenoblade Chronicles. They were made after organisms on Bionis were analysed.
Ether II Goggles (Japanese: , Ēteru II Gōguru) are Mechonis goggles in Xenoblade Chronicles. They have been improved by the Machina.
Ether IV Goggles (Japanese: , Ēteru IV Gōguru) are Mechonis goggles in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Ether V Goggles (Japanese: , Ēteru V Gōguru) are Mechonis goggles in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are Mechon head parts made by fusing technology from Mechonis and Bionis.

Etoile Snipers (Japanese: , Etowārusunaipu) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are rifles that can be wielded by Sharla. They can be acquired by purchasing them in Colony 6 for 13,920 G. They can also be acquired by trading with Merisa who can be found in Alcamoth.

Evil Bathin (Japanese: , Akuma no Batin) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a Mechon, and can be found at level 54 inside the Ether Exhaust System on the Fallen Arm. It must be defeated to complete the quest Scheduled Inspection given by Xekit at the Ether Light of the Hidden Machina Village. The Mechonis Key is required to enter the Ether Exhaust System, which is earned after completing The Wilted Flower, making that quest a prerequisite for fighting this unique monster.

The Experimental M86 (Japanese: , Shingata Dōryoku no Hachijūrokushiki) is a quest-exclusive enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a Mechon. It can be found at level 75 and appears in the Digit 2 Plain, under the Digit 1 Crevasse during The Mini Reactor. It must be defeated to get the quest item Mini Reactor. This enemy deals close range Spike damage.
The Exhaust Pump is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is dropped by the Offensive Hover Unit, and is needed for The Exhaust Pump.
F Attack Arms are Mechonis arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.
F Speed Arms are Mechonis arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.

Experienced Tristan (Japanese: , Rōkyū no Torisutan, Decrepit Tristan) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a Mechon, and can be found at level 64 on the second floor of Agniratha, southwest of the 1st Control Platform. It can drop Advanced Frames needed for A Weapon Just For Me.

Ether Protect (Japanese: , Ēteru Baria) is a Gem in that is activated at the beginning of combat, and reduces Ether damage for 30 seconds. A Buff Time Plus Gem can increase the duration to a maximum of 75 seconds. __TOC__

Ether Ignas are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Igna family, and can be found from level 20-25 near the Crown Tree, near Zaldania Waterfall, and in Igna Territory in Satorl Marsh. They can drop the Igna Stone Pots needed for Nopon Determination.
Ether Wisdom is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. Obtaining it is one of the objectives of With Even More Gratitude. It can be found at the Believer's Paradise on the Bionis' Leg.

The External Sensor is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be found in the Silver Wreckage on the Fallen Arm after receiving Mysterious Noises from Prox. The External Sensor is the source of the noises which are frightening the villagers. Returning with it to Prox completes the quest.

The Ether Storage Area (Japanese: , Ēteru Chozō-ku) is a location in . It is located in Sword Valley, west of the Monado Wound. The Ether Storage Area contains the Enalda Control Base, which in turn contains the button that allows the 3rd Gate to open.
This page is a list of all the Unique Monsters in the Ether Mine.

The Ether Influx Conduit (Japanese: , Ēteru Ryūnyū Kanritsūro) is a landmark in . It is located on the ground floor of Galahad Fortress. It is the first landmark in the fortress, and it leads to the Main Maintenance Bay, which branches off into three fuel supply rooms.

The Ether Input Stream (Japanese: , Ēteru Chūnyūro) is a location in . It is located on the second basement floor of Galahad Fortress, and is a large open room with wheel-like machines on either side of a large Ether river. This Ether flows to the Ether Blast Furnace, which is directly west of the Input Stream.
FN Site 106 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located on Fallshorn Isle, north of Biahno Lake in Primordia.

Everlasting Millesaurs (Japanese: , Ebārasuto Mirezauro) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Millesaur family, and can be found at level 51-60 near Biahno Lake or at Sayram Northeast Plain and Janpath Lake in Primordia. Two must be defeated to complete the Basic Mission Mincing Millesaurs.

Ether Planters are devices in Xenoblade Chronicles. They resemble huge tuning forks, and collect Ether from the air around them, giving them a distinctive glow. There are a number of them in and around Colony 6 to supply ether for the reconstruction process.

Everyday Life (日常, Daily Life) is an Event Track in and , composed and arranged by Manami Kiyota. It is track 4 of disc 1 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack, the Xenoblade Definitive Edition Original Soundtrack, and the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This music is a light, cheery theme that is heard in the following cutscenes: * Shulk and Reyn's conversation after the game's first monster battles at the Mechon Wreckage Site near Colony 9. * Shulk agrees to accompany Reyn to Mag Mell Ruins after receiving his first visions from the Monado in the Weapon Development Lab. * Riki explains to Shulk and the rest of the party why he became the Heropon of Frontier Village. Excavator is a level 60 Skell model unit in and . Excavator is one of the Skells of the BLADE in New Los Angeles. It was a part of Alexa's DLC in the Japanese version, but is included as part of the base game in Europe and North America. The blueprints are unlocked as a reward for completing Alexa's final Affinity Mission Rapid Misfire. Like other crafted Skells, the Excavator has 10 units of Skell insurance instead of the 3 units found in store-bought and the story-received Skell. Although the Excavator is level 60, it comes with an initial level 50 armor but that armor is slightly better than the other level 50 initial Skell models. The Ether Light Shop is a shop in . It is the sole shop in Colony 9, located at the Ether Light in the Commercial District. After the Mechon raid, one weapon (Fiora's Defence Knives) is dropped and several new items are added to this shop's inventory. __TOC__
FN Site 121 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is at the easternmost point of Primordia, near the entrance to Oblivia.

FN Site 117 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia, near West Janpath Plain and directly west of Janpath Lake. The Normal Mission The Probe-fessional requires a Data Probe be placed and a Research Probe G1 installed as part of its objectives. The normal mission Proficiency Exam 1 also requires a Data Probe be placed here, but since The Probe-fessional must be completed as a prerequisite to Chapter 4, it is impossible to accept Proficiency Exam 1 without having already placed a probe, therefore making the mission auto-complete itself.
FN Site 301 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Oblivia, at the Oblivia Ingress. It is the first deposit accessable in Oblivia.
FN Site 302 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Oblivia, northeast of Oblivia Ingress.

FN Site 116 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia, near East Gate Plain. The party is sent here in Chapter 2 of the main plot, where they find it guarded by the Volkampf, the Pursuer, which they defeat. They then connect their first Data Probe here, activating the FrontierNav. During the Normal Mission The Probe-fessional, Kirsty tasks Cross with installing a Mining Probe G1 on this site, along with FN Site 112 and FN Site 114, to demonstrate FrontierNav link combos.
FN Site 119 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia near the Seaswept Base. Some Prone Majors can be found guarding the site.

FN Site 101 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located on a cliff in northwest Primordia, close to the entrance to Noctilum. There are no enemies here. A Mechanical level of 5 is required to place a probe here.

FN Site 102 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Starfall Basin in Primordia. Interestingly its position on the map suggests that it should be FN Site 103 rather than 102, and visa versa.
FN Site 103 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located at the Green Threshold in Primordia.
FN Site 104 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia, west of Biahno Lake.

FN Site 105 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia on a northern outcrop of land, northeast of Stickstone Rise and north of Unicorn Rock. There are no enemies there.
